thread:
Anna: FYI — onboarding flow for tenant ACME stalled during webhook auth; customers hitting 401s on initial sync. Need comms + quick mitigation.
Mike: ack. How many onboarders affected?
Anna: ~14 active trial tenants started today; 5 are high-touch (enterprise). Renewal/expansion risk if we don't respond quickly.
Priya: timeline? root cause?
Sam: looks like a recent config change to our VPC auth header logic. Patch queued, but takes ~20–30m to roll through staging→prod.
Jordan: @Sam estimated deploy window — do we have a canary plan or rollback if it fails?
Sam: rolling canary: 2% traffic first, if good then 30m ramp. Fallback is immediate rollback to previous deploy.
Anna: CS ask: need two comms drafts — an initial status to all affected tenants, and a tailored exec note for the 5 high-touch accounts. Also we should offer a quick enablement session for the onboarding teams.
Mike: I'll draft the status note. Quick one: include ETA, what we're doing, how we're making customers whole (credit/extended trial), and an enablement offer.
Priya: For exec notes, include the expected fix timeline, mitigation steps, and a 1:1 technical bridge offer. I'll tailor for the enterprise contacts.
Anna: credit proposal: 3 days of trial extension + optional onboarding session. OK?
Jordan: sounds reasonable. For 2 of the enterprise tenants flagged as at-risk, suggest 5-day extension and a CX hold.
Sam: deploy started: canary at 02:10 UTC. I'll post updates.
DeployBot: deploy/patch-3023 started by sam — canary 2% at 02:10 UTC. link: https://deploys.redwood/3023
Sam: canary good. No 5xx spike. ramping to 25%.
Mike: draft status note (short):

Anna (Customer Success) here — we’re aware of an issue affecting initial onboarding syncs resulting in "401 Unauthorized" for some customers. Our engineers identified a configuration regression and a patch is rolling out now. Expected full recovery in ~30–45 minutes. We’ll extend your trial by 3 days and can schedule a 30-minute onboarding session to get you back on track. Reply here or DM to book. Apologies for the disruption. :pray:

Would love a quick review before I send.
Anna: looks good. Add line: "No customer data was exposed; this is an auth failure only." Good to reassure security-conscious contacts.
Priya: added exec note bullet points and suggested subject lines. Sharing after this thread.
Jordan: I'll call the two at-risk accounts after we confirm recovery. Can we surface a short enablement checklist for the session? (auth webhook example, retry logic, logs to watch)
Mike: adding checklist link.
- Verify webhook URL + credentials
- Confirm retry/backoff config
- Validate initial payload sample in logs
- Walk through sample successful sync
Anna: Assign owners: Mike sends the broad status to the 14 tenants once Sam confirms full recovery. Priya sends the 5 exec notes. Jordan dials the two priority accounts. Sam to post final deploy status and confirm rollback plan still in place.
Sam: full prod ramp complete at 02:41 UTC. No regressions observed. Patch ID 3023.
DeployBot: deploy/patch-3023 completed — full rollout OK at 02:41 UTC.
Anna: sending outbound now. Will include credit offer and enablement booking link. Also logging feedback ask: "What would have helped you notice this faster?" short survey link attached.
Mike: sent status email to affected list at 02:46 UTC. Copy pasted here for records.
Mike: "Subject: Update on onboarding sync issue — temporary auth regression

Anna (Redwood Inference) — We're writing to let you know we experienced an auth regression affecting initial onboarding syncs. A fix was rolled out and services are healthy. We’re extending your trial by 3 days and offering a free onboarding session. Please reply to book or use this link: https://cal.redwood/onboard. No customer data exposure was detected. Apologies for the disruption.

If you have feedback on detection/alerts we’d love to hear: https://redwood/survey-onboard-ops"
Anna: thanks; I'll follow up with exec notes and schedule calls.
Priya: I'll prepare postmortem bullets for CS template and a recommended alert tweak (raise auth 401 thresholds for onboarding flows).
Jordan: post-incident: I'll capture notes from calls and escalate any churn concerns to AMs. Creating a follow-up checklist in the CS board.
Anna: great. Closing actions: add credits, send exec notes, schedule enablement sessions, collect feedback + update alerts. Reopen thread if any reports persist. :white_check_mark:
